text: I am going to bulk until I look like an anime villain.
Wide back, arms like carved stone, and a V-taper so sharp it looks fake.

But whenever I tell people they can build a body like this, I hear the same three excuses: "I don't have the genetics," "I don't have the time," "It's not possible naturally." So I am going to show you what is possible.
This is me after seven years of training.
Decent, but I am not a genetic freak.
I work full time in tech, and I am also a fitness coach.
And I have been a Type One diabetic since I was twelve.
If I can build this body, so can you.
I am already two months into this bulk, but from today, I am filming all of it.
Training, food, supplements, the wins and the days it goes wrong.
But I am not stopping until I look like him
